objective: Add a bounded evaluation-set admission ledger binding immutable task/split/grader manifests to policy generation, coverage, independence, overlap, contamination, expiry, and complete candidate results without creating datasets, executing models, grading traces, or approving releases.

research_inputs.finding: Trace debugging should precede repeatable dataset and evaluation runs when benchmarking workflow changes over time.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: The contract binds a stable task-set, split, grader, baseline/candidate, task-result, and trace-result digest but does not itself execute or grade them.

research_inputs.finding: Structured trace grading supports workflow-level regression analysis across tool calls, handoffs, safety policies, and end-to-end behavior.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: Result verification requires complete task coverage and zero safety failures while treating grader and trace receipts as untrusted evidence rather than authority.

research_inputs.finding: Governed runtime evolution requires lifecycle state, validation, traceability, evaluation, dependencies, and rollback rather than unrestricted self-modification.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: The manifest is generation/expiry bound, requires independent split/grader declarations, rejects overlap/contamination, and preserves a rollback checkpoint.

features: policy generation and platform ABI binding
minimum task count and coverage gates
zero overlap and contamination policy gates
manifest/result/nonce replay and digest tamper protection

benchmark.scope: local Python control-plane manifest/result verification overhead; excludes dataset creation, model invocation, trace grading, network, storage, accelerators, kernel scheduling, and release approval latency

rollback.rollback_scope: remove the evaluation-set module, tests, runner, evidence registration, and metadata; retain prior tagged self-improvement release

limitations: The ledger verifies caller-supplied manifests and results; it does not create datasets, sample tasks, execute models, grade traces, or verify that independence and contamination claims are true.
No external grader, dataset service, model provider, trace backend, cryptographic signer, or remote anchor was contacted.
The benchmark measures local Python control-plane overhead and excludes evaluation execution, model, tool, network, storage, accelerator, kernel scheduler, and approval latency.
The real-task validation is a deterministic local fixture and does not establish agent quality, general intelligence, browser autonomy, robotics, or production efficacy.
No physical accelerator, TPM, secure enclave, independent builder, live multihost deployment, or independent external security review was exercised.
This evidence does not claim AGI capability, production approval, or superiority to Linux.
